task: Search for a high-protein vegetarian chili recipe on Allrecipes that has at least 50 reviews and a rating of 4 stars or higher. Provide the ingredient list, cooking time, and a brief description of the cooking steps.
answer: Recipe: Meatiest Vegetarian Chili from Your Slow Cooker (Allrecipes #132394, https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/132394/meatiest-vegetarian-chili-from-your-slow-cooker/). Rating: 4.6 stars (346 ratings, 232 reviews) — meets the >=4 stars and >=50 reviews requirements. High-protein vegetarian: 21g protein per serving, built on firm tofu and black beans, categorized under Chili Recipes > Vegetarian. Cooking time: Cook Time 6 hrs 15 mins (Prep Time 25 mins, Total Time 6 hrs 40 mins), serves 8. Ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil; 4 onions, chopped; 2 green bell peppers, seeded and chopped; 2 red bell peppers, seeded and chopped; 1 (14 ounce) package firm tofu, drained and cubed; 4 cloves garlic, minced; 4 (15.5 ounce) cans black beans, drained; 2 (15 ounce) cans crushed tomatoes; 6 tablespoons chili powder; 2 tablespoons dried oregano; 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar; 1 tablespoon liquid hot pepper sauce (e.g. Tabasco); 2 teaspoons ground cumin; 2 teaspoons salt; 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper. Brief cooking steps: Step 1 — Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the onions until softening, then add the bell peppers, tofu, and garlic and cook about 10 minutes until lightly browned; transfer the mixture to the slow cooker. Step 2 — Stir in the black beans, crushed tomatoes, chili powder, oregano, vinegar, hot pepper sauce, cumin, salt, and black pepper; cover and cook on Low for about 6 hours, then adjust seasoning and serve.
